issues.description: The template version of dd.py defines UniqueTable.__init__(self, size: int) (requiring a size argument), but later in the same template file the global UT is created with UT = UniqueTable() (no argument). The solution version of dd.py defines UniqueTable.__init__(self) with no size parameter. This mismatch in constructor parameters in the template causes an import/run error (TypeError) and prevents students from executing or testing their code.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the UniqueTable constructor signature in the template match the solution and usage. Either remove the size parameter (define def __init__(self) -> None:) as in the solution, or change the global UT instantiation to pass an appropriate size (e.g., UT = UniqueTable(some_size)). Prefer removing the size parameter so UniqueTable() can be constructed without arguments, matching the intended usage in dd.py and the solution.
